'''Shields''' are [[weapons]] that can be used with other one-handed weapons. The [[block]] power, [[parry]] force and parry bonus of the weapons used with shields would be replaced by that of the shield used. '''Tower shields''' offer the highest raw block power and force at the cost of usually 10% slower movement (this equally increases dodge roll cost) when in hand compared to other shields' 5%, and no parrying, which allows other shields to achieve higher block armor in parrying. '''Buckler shields''' offer the best parry block armor but the weakest block armor and parry force. {{infobox weapon | title = Staff of Frost | description = A staff as cold as the three-year winter that will herald the end of times. | id = StaffIceShards | type = Elemental magic | source = [[Galdr Table]] | light source = Light blue | weight = 0.3 | crafting level = 1 | repair level = 1 | materials 1 = * [[Yggdrasil Wood]] x20 * [[Freeze Gland]] x4 * [[Refined Eitr]] x16 | materials 2 = * [[Yggdrasil Wood]] x10 * [[Freeze Gland]] x2 * [[Refined Eitr]] x8 | materials 3 = * [[Yggdrasil Wood]] x20 * [[Freeze Gland]] x4 * [[Refined Eitr]] x16 | materials 4 = * [[Yggdrasil Wood]] x40 * [[Freeze Gland]] x8 * [[Refined Eitr]] x32 | frost = 30 | frost per level= 2 | eitr = 5 | block armor = 48 | block force = 20 | block force per level = 5 | parry bonus = 2 | knockback = 10 | movement speed = -5% | durability = 200 | wielding = Two-handed | adrenaline = 1 }} The '''Staff of Frost''' is one of four [[Magic]] weapons introduced in the [[Mistlands]] update. Its primary attack fires freezing shards of ice at a rapid pace with low accuracy. While its poor accuracy limits the staff's effective range severely, the freezing effect slows any enemies hit by the attack.
